name: Hamutal
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem, and his mother was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

note.label: Jeremiah 52: The Fall of Jerusalem and the Puppet King Zedekiah
